notes.title: First Major Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Just posted an update to the game that added a few things

I added a simple Save Game feature so if you have to leave the game you can save it and resume it later - I might add the possibility to save more than one game in the future but wanted to get this to you asap :)

I also redid the alien renders - they were LIVE shots of the aliens and just weren't very good quality, so I rendered out the videos and added them instead, which had the added bonus of freeing up a lot of space!

and lastly I added a small description to the buttons that start the games to let you know what you are getting into! ;)

oh and I added a little summary to the Game Won graphic so you can see how many planets you discovered, conquered and colonized 

There's other stuff still in the works! 

Thanks
Jamie
